method: Exploratory Sardinas–Patterson assay during statement audit
scope: Finite preliminary normalization check only. Not a search for a new obstruction and not an all-order noncompletion proof. The final proof instead obtains n>=20 directly from the necessary cyclic factorization and injectivity of the forced residue sets; it does not depend on this assay.
novelty: None claimed; far weaker than Cordero2019 n=330*k, k>=4.
